blocks.text: Filipino pop powerhouse SB19 has reached a new career milestone with a nomination for Best Asian Pop Music Performance at the 69th Annual GRAMMY® Awards, cementing their status as trailblazers of P-Pop on the world stage. Adding to their momentum, the quintet is set to make their Coachella debut in 2027, becoming the second P-pop act to take the iconic festival’s stage in consecutive years. They will join a star-studded lineup alongside headliners Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA, bringing Filipino music to one of the world’s most celebrated music festivals.
